share.title: Share
share.hotspot.unsupported: This phone cannot create a hotspot for an app (it needs Android 8 or newer).
share.hotspot.incompatible: Your phone's own hotspot is on, so the app cannot start one. Use that instead: have the other phone join it.
share.hotspot.disallowed: Hotspots are switched off on this phone by its owner or carrier.
share.hotspot.permission: The app needs the Nearby devices (or Location) permission to create a hotspot.
share.intro: Let a phone next to you chat with this one from its browser, and give it the app. This phone keeps serving both until you stop sharing; no internet is needed.
share.hotspot.scan: On the other phone, scan this with the camera to join the hotspot, or join it by hand:
share.hotspot.offer: Both phones on the same Wi-Fi already? Go to step 2. Otherwise this phone can make a private hotspot for the other to join.
share.hotspot.manual: You can also switch on the hotspot in this phone's system settings, have the other phone join it, and come back here.
share.chat.no_network: This phone is not on any Wi-Fi or hotspot yet. Finish step 1, then tap Refresh.
share.chat.scan: On the other phone, scan this with the camera and open the link (or type it into the browser):
share.app.how: The chat page links to it. To skip the chat, scan this and tap Download{mb}, then open the file; if Android asks, allow the browser to install apps and tap Install.
share.app.abi: This copy is built for {abi} phones; a much older phone may refuse it.
